Rendering: 2029 BMW 5 Series Abandons the Neue Klasse Design Altogether and Heads in a New Direction
6 photos
Photo: tedoradze.giorgi / Instagram
The premium Bavarian automaker is reportedly offering an insane compensation package to around 8k employees to abandon the company by the end of 2027, but maybe they should consider paying a lot less to secure the employment of this member of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators instead of letting him dwell across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI.
According to a recent report, BMW’s new severance package is worth up to $730k for some employees, though it probably has a lot to do with age, salary, and tenure, to begin with. On the other hand, they aren’t backing out of model releases, just human resources.
Thus, we know that upcoming new or refreshed models include the BMW 5 Series, the ICE and EV variants of the all-new BMW M3, as well as the company’s largest SUV to date. Soon, a BMW X9 could take the Neue Klasse design to new dimensions complete with the CLAR architecture and powerful gasoline engines, to create a new flagship SUV aimed squarely at America and fighting its way to the sales charts with the likes of the new Audi Q9 and also the classic Caddy Escalade.
On the other hand, this virtual artist - Giorgi Tedoradze, the Georgia-based industrial designer better known as " tedoradze.giorgi " on social media- has a stylish BMW 5 Series in his CGI-loving mind as an alternative to the hulking SUV or the upcoming brazen compact executive sedan.
We already know that the current eighth generation G60 BMW 5 Series executive car is up for a mid-cycle refresh procedure, dubbed LCI (Life Cycle Impulse) over at BMW, as we have received the latest spy photos of prototypes from our spy photographer partners. The scoops clearly show that the LCI will bring the 5 Series in line with the Neue Klasse ethos, by the way.
But this pixel master proposes an alternative: an all-new 2029 BMW 5 Series that completely abandons the Neue Klasse design in favor of a return to physical ‘angel eyes’, albeit modernized, and to 3D-sculpted regular-size kidney grilles, among others. The BMW 5 Series depicted here in CGI also has a sporty allure with large vents in the front bumper, an athletic profile with a high beltline and a sculpted low body line.
Around the back, this unofficial, hypothetical design proposal comes with slim L-shaped LED taillights, a subtle ducktail trunk shape, and a visceral bumper packing a massive motorsport-inspired diffuser. Also of note is the fact that we’re dealing with an ICE or electrified BMW 5 Series, not the BMW i5 version, as hinted by the dual exhaust outlets neatly integrated into the massive diffuser. So, what do you think – yay or nay? View this post on Instagram A post shared by Giorgi Tedoradze (@tedoradze.giorgi)
